value.answer: Call 911 now. A child who is floppy and drowsy after a seizure needs emergency care, even though the shaking has stopped. Lay them on their side, put nothing in their mouth, and stay with them.
value.triage: Call 911 now - do not wait to see if they perk up. Tell the dispatcher if the shaking restarts, the lips or face turn blue, or breathing is hard. Health811 (811) is for nurse advice afterward, not for this moment.
